notes: ADR-0066. The image digest is deliberately UNRESOLVED. Pulling an image needs network access and repository-owner authorization that has not been given, so no digest has been resolved and no container has ever been built or run for this role. Until the owner replaces digest_status with pinned, supplies image_digest and the matching repository@sha256 image_reference, and sets authorization_status to authorized_for_bounded_generated_code_execution, every CampaignExperimentSandbox call refuses with image_digest_unresolved. A missing, unpinned, or mismatched digest is a refusal and never a fallback. forbidden_reuse_digests names the Phase 4B parser image: ADR-0057 section 2 forbids reusing a parser-specific sandbox for generated code, so pinning that digest here is itself a refusal.
